SELECT e.*, emp.name AS nurse_name, b.bed_number AS bed_number FROM elderly e LEFT JOIN employee emp ON e.nurse_id = emp.id LEFT JOIN bed b ON e.bed_id = b.id WHERE e.is_deleted = 0 /* 核心逻辑：只查那些在影像表(imaging)里存在记录的老人 */ AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM medical_img img WHERE img.elder_id = e.id AND img.is_deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY e.check_in_date DESC
